description: Implementation of ext2 filesystem operations for Zephyr RTOS, including block management, inode handling, directory operations, and filesystem initialization.

methods.name: error_behavior
methods.description: Handles filesystem error behaviors based on superblock settings, including panic, read-only mode, or continue.

methods.name: get_block_struct
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new ext2 block structure with associated memory slab buffers.

methods.name: ext2_get_block
methods.description: Fetches a block from the filesystem by number, reading data via backend operations.

methods.name: ext2_get_empty_block
methods.description: Creates a new empty block with zeroed data.

methods.name: ext2_write_block
methods.description: Writes a block to the filesystem via backend operations.

methods.name: ext2_drop_block
methods.description: Frees the memory associated with a block.

methods.name: ext2_init_blocks_slab
methods.description: Initializes memory slabs for block structures and buffers.

methods.name: ext2_assign_block_num
methods.description: Assigns a new block number to a block structure, allocating it from the filesystem.

methods.name: ext2_init_storage
methods.description: Initializes filesystem storage, setting device size, write size, and backend access.

methods.name: ext2_verify_disk_superblock
methods.description: Validates the superblock of an ext2 filesystem, checking magic number, revision, features, and consistency.

methods.name: ext2_init_fs
methods.description: Mounts and initializes the ext2 filesystem, fetching superblock and block groups, and validating filesystem consistency.

methods.name: ext2_close_fs
methods.description: Closes the filesystem, flushing changes and freeing resources.

methods.name: ext2_close_struct
methods.description: Resets the filesystem data structure and marks it as uninitialized.

methods.name: ext2_lookup_inode
methods.description: Resolves a path to an inode, traversing directories and handling creation/stat/unlink flags.

methods.name: ext2_inode_read
methods.description: Reads data from an inode into a buffer, handling block fetching.

methods.name: ext2_inode_write
methods.description: Writes data to an inode, allocating blocks as needed.

methods.name: ext2_inode_trunc
methods.description: Truncates or extends an inode to a specified size, managing block allocation/removal.

methods.name: ext2_get_direntry
methods.description: Reads a directory entry from a directory inode.
